name: Denso QR two-dimensional code
description: Machine-readable two-dimensional code designed to hold and retrieve information from a compact printed symbol.

impact.note: A faster two-dimensional code among existing ones, now scanned by phone users across many countries; convenience rather than a new ability, with payment and ticketing uses following.

date.basis: Date in the cited source; see scope and caveats.

events.statement: Denso developed the QR Code for manufacturing information and parts handling.

evidence.supports: Denso attributes the 1994 code to the need for efficient manufacturing data reading.

contributions.resource: Developed the code for manufacturing use.

events.caveats: Availability is not a count of scanners or people using the code.
